facts.fact: 祖母一眼看出供品少了菠萝，先挑错不夸人
祖母摇铃念咒，坟里的尸体直挺挺立起
facts.anchor: the corpses stood up in their graves

facts.fact: Kiamling 用气纵跃，给每具尸体额头贴符
facts.anchor: fastening a fu talisman to each forehead

facts.fact: 狐狸精故意把醉酒的英国军官引进赶尸队伍
facts.anchor: led a merry chase deliberately into their column

facts.fact: 军官醉酒扯下尸体脸上的符纸要吻她，尸体化作僵尸
facts.anchor: Inebriated, he ripped the fu talisman off the corpse’s face to kiss it

facts.fact: Kiamling 用铜钱剑斩下僵尸头颅，祖母喊停已迟
facts.anchor: Kiamling held her sword in both hands and lopped off the geongsi’s head.

facts.fact: 四具尸体同时站起，祖母取八卦镜、她撒糯米
军官推她当盾，她反口说他肉更嫩
祖母杖击僵尸、重新贴符，讥她蹲着不动
facts.anchor: Are you planning on squatting there all night?

facts.fact: 祖母解释：有人带着怒气死了，符镇不住
她向军官开账单：驱邪、损毁、洗衣费
facts.anchor: Who shall we make the bill out to?
